section.content: 一种半导体集成电路，存储器(11)、可以与存储器(11)连接的多个逻辑部(12A、12B)、和使多个逻辑部(12A、12B)的任一个与存储器(11)连接，而其它逻辑部与存储器(11)隔离的隔离部(13)。通过隔离部(13)，将多个逻辑部(12A、12B)中所需要的一个与存储器(11)连接，其它不需要的与存储器(11)隔离。这样，由于在扩散后可以切换系统LSI，可以采用一个曝光用掩模进行多个系统LSI的制造，提高生产效率。另外，可以进行不合格逻辑部的救助，提高扩散工艺后的成品率。因而，可以提高混合载置了存储器和进行数据处理的逻辑部的半导体集成电路的生产效率以及成品率。

A semiconductor integrated circuit with integrated memory and data-processing logic portions is provided, with which productivity and yield can be improved. The semiconductor integrated circuit is provided with a memory, a plurality of logic portions that are capable of being connected to the memory, and a separation portion that connects one of the plurality of logic portions to the memory, while separating the other logic portions from the memory. One required logic portion of the plurality of logic portions is connected to the memory, and the other non-required logic portions are separated from the memory, by the separation portion. The semiconductor integrated circuit can be switched for a system LSI after wafer processing, so this enables a plurality of system LSIs to be manufactured using the same exposure masks, thus improving productivity. Furthermore, defective logic portions can be recovered, thus improving the yield.

Semiconductor integrated circuitTechnical field

The present invention relates to a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit, particularly mix the technology of the mounting memory and the semiconductor integrated circuit of the logic section of carrying out data processing.

Background technology

In recent years, along with the microminiaturization of DRAM (Dynamic Random Access Memory), carry out the mixing mountingization that the logic section of data processing forms with microprocessor and ASIC (Application Specific IC) etc. on a semiconductor integrated circuit substrates and begun to prevail.This semiconductor integrated circuit with memory and logic section mixing mounting is called system LSI.

As the advantage of system LSI, following 2 points are arranged.At first be, eliminated the restriction that the number of pins because of DRAM causes, data width that can the growth data input and output can rapidly improve the data transfer rate between DRAM and the logic section.It two is that the line between DRAM and the logic section can adopt short-range metal line, can significantly reduce the parasitic capacitance in the input and output wiring, reduces the power consumption of semiconductor integrated circuit.

In addition, in DRAM, be equipped with redundant memory cell in advance.Like this, the defective qualified memory cell that produces in diffusion technology in the redundancy relief technology of memory, can be replaced as the redundant memory unit of preparation.Like this, can guarantee the rate of finished products that relevant DRAM makes.

System LSI, multiple situation are to make towards special-purpose.In the manufacturing of such semiconductor integrated circuit towards special-purpose, need independent exposure mask.In addition, towards the semiconductor integrated circuit of special-purpose, need respectively through separately independently manufacturing process make.But in recent years, in the manufacture process of semiconductor integrated circuit, along with the propelling of miniaturization, the making of exposure mask becomes and wants the cost of both expensive.For this reason, make independent exposure mask, increased manufacturing cost at system LSI.

In addition, in prior art system LSI, even DRAM has prepared the redundant memory unit of displacement usefulness, but logic section is not carried redundant logic section.For this reason, the defective qualified logic section that produces in diffusion technology can't obtain relief, makes the semiconductor integrated circuit result with this defective qualified logic section become defective item.Reduce rate of finished products like this, thereby also can increase the manufacturing cost of semiconductor integrated circuit.

At the problems referred to above, the objective of the invention is to, undertaken from developing to after the technology that spreads by adopting with an exposure mask, switch to system LSI again, thereby can realize improving the production efficiency that memory such as DRAM and logic section such as microprocessor and ASIC are mixed the semiconductor integrated circuit of mountings as the special-purpose of purpose.In addition, another purpose is can succour, improve rate of finished products to the defective logic section that produces in the diffusion technology of semiconductor integrated circuit.

In order to solve above-mentioned problem, constitute device of the present invention, as semiconductor integrated circuit, comprise memory, can be connected with above-mentioned memory, respectively carry out data processing a plurality of logic section, make in above-mentioned a plurality of logic section any is connected with above-mentioned memory and isolation part that other logic section and above-mentioned memory are isolated at least.

(the 1st embodiment)

Fig. 1 represents the pie graph of the semiconductor integrated circuit of relevant the present invention the 1st embodiment.The semiconductor integrated circuit of relevant present embodiment, be on a substrate, mix mounting memory 11, microprocessor and ASIC (Application Specific IC) etc. such as DRAM (DynamicRandom Access Memory), SRAM (Static Random Access Memory), flash memory, ROM (Read Only Memory), ferroelectric storage carry out logic section 12A, the 12B of data processing and the circuit of isolation part 13.

Though do not draw among the figure, memory 11 and logic section 12A, 12B comprise address terminal, data input pin, data output end, data input and output terminal, clock terminal etc. respectively.These terminals of logic section 12A, 12B are connected with isolation part 13 respectively by wiring W1, W2.Like this, logic section 12A, 12B by isolation part 13, can be connected with memory 11.

Isolation part 13 has a plurality of (being 2 in the present embodiment) fuse circuit 131 or the anti-fuse circuit 131 that is arranged between memory 11 and logic section 12A, the 12B.The anti-fuse of the fuse of fuse circuit 131 or anti-fuse circuit 131 distributes with the wiring that is connected with the various terminals of these various terminal corresponding memory 11 according to each terminal with logic section 12A, 12B respectively.In addition, these fuses and anti-fuse for example can use in the redundancy relief of DRAM.

For the semiconductor integrated circuit of relevant present embodiment, adopt an exposure mask that comprises logic section 12A, 12B both sides, carry out the technology that spreads from developing to.For fuse circuit 131, because fuse is in contact condition, the both sides of logic section 12A, 12B are in the state that is connected with memory 11 in the semiconductor integrated circuit after diffusion technology finishes.But if move under this state, the output of logic section 12A, 12B can cause conflict by isolation part 13, becomes the reason of bad action.In addition, the output of memory 11 must drive the parasitic capacitance that colonizes on wiring W1, the W2 both sides, has increased unnecessary power consumption.

For this reason, isolation part 13 is connected any that needs among logic section 12A, the 12B with memory 11, and unwanted logic section 12A, 12B and memory 11 are isolated.For example, when logic section 12A is connected with memory 11, and when logic section 12B and memory 11 isolated, all fuses of relevant logic section 12B are adopted laser reconditioning cut-outs such as (trimming), make logic section 12B and memory 11 isolation.Like this, semiconductor integrated circuit has only logic section 12A and memory 11 to be in connection status.

On the other hand, for anti-fuse circuit 131, the semiconductor integrated circuit after diffusion technology finishes is owing to anti-fuse place nonconducting state, and the both sides of logic section 12A, 12B and memory 11 are in the state of isolation.Therefore, isolation part 13 applies voltage on the anti-fuse of relevant logic section 12A, makes these anti-fuses be in conducting state, and logic section 12A is connected with memory 11.

For the cut-out of the fuse that carries out fuse circuit 131 or carry out the conducting of the anti-fuse of anti-fuse circuit 131, need append new manufacturing process.These for example can be succoured technology (becoming the technology of underproof memory cell with the redundant memory replacement unit of preparation in manufacturing process) in memory redundancy and carry out.

More than, has present embodiment, after the exposed mask that employing comprises logic section 12A, 12B carries out the diffusion of semiconductor integrated circuit, by isolation part 13, among logic section 12A, the 12B any is connected with memory 11, and another logic section and memory 11 are isolated.Like this, the semiconductor integrated circuit after the diffusion can switch to various system LSIs, can improve the production efficiency of semiconductor integrated circuit.In addition, can realize the redundancy relief of logic section, in diffusion technology, improve rate of finished products.Further, by with unwanted logic section from physically isolating with memory 11, can reduce the power consumption of semiconductor integrated circuit and realize the high speed of action.
